_description: The order of screens after the player presses Enter on the title screen. Steps run top to bottom. Step types: 'sequence' = a click-through slideshow ('sequence' is a file name in content/sequences/, without .json). 'card' = a black screen with one line of text ('text'), shown for 'holdSeconds' seconds; 'stopMusic': true fades the music out as it appears. More step types (pop-up, map) are added in later build steps.
_usedIn: Simulation page → everything between the title screen and the game

steps._location: Right after Enter on the title screen
Black screen after the last intro slide
